upstream.target: portable scalar x86_64 Linux LP64 build

summary.en: Top-down Lean 4 safety invariants and strict ISO C17 runtime bootstrap for the 7-Zip pure-C SDK (.7z container DAG, BCJ2, PPMd7 arena allocator, LZMA/LZMA2); full C translation safety proofs are not done.
summary.zh: 针对官方 7-Zip 纯 C SDK（.7z 容器 DAG、BCJ2、PPMd7 内存池子分配器、LZMA/LZMA2）的 Lean 4 顶层安全不变量模型与严格 ISO C17 运行时基座；完整 C 翻译的安全性证明尚未完成。
